instruction: Add a footer to the slide with the text 'Art History 101'

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a footer with specific text. Evaluator checks if any shape in the slide contains the footer text.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks for footer-specific placeholders using shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER.FOOTER
Logic properly distinguishes between footer placeholders and arbitrary text boxes on the slide
Complete coverage: Verifies both that it's a footer placeholder AND that it contains the required text 'Art History 101'

Minor issue: Uses substring match ('footer_text in shape.text') instead of exact match, which could cause false positives if footer contains additional text beyond 'Art History 101'. However, this is acceptable for most practical cases since footers typically contain the exact text added.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using exact match (shape.text == footer_text or shape.text.strip() == footer_text) instead of substring match to avoid false positives if footer has additional text
